name: An Ape's Life
summary:
A new type of ape has been discovered...

These apes have adapted to human thinking, but there's a twist... they don't have legs! To take advantage of this situation, they use their hands to move! 

They have discovered areas such as a nice forest, a modern building, and so much more!

So what are you waiting for? Come along and learn what it is like to be in an ape's life!
